TXN_ENTITLEMENT_LEDGER: delta (+N saat VERIFIED, -1 saat deduct PRESENT/LATE/NO_SHOW/LATE_CANCEL, 0 saat valid/teacher cancel)
CLASS_MEMBERSHIP: sisa ledger-derived (PUBLIC 4 sesi; trial-credit -7 bila konversi)
CLASS_SESSIONS: session_id SES-XXXXXX kanonikal per jadwal kelas (KOL-POL-COD-001)
REVIEWS: at (diisi setelah 1 paket selesai, semua sesi hadir)

flows.trial: 7 trial gratis (6 belajar + Sesi 7 Progress Test) di TRIALS; COMPLETED → layak konversi
flows.checkout: Checkout Public -> ENR + TXN PENDING -> webhook -> VERIFIED
flows.verify: VERIFIED -> grant +N (PUBLIC 4 sesi); bila trial COMPLETED tambah -7 TRIAL_RECOGNITION (exactly once). Buat N SES + N event Calendar + audit
flows.attendance: Guru input PRESENT/LATE/NO_SHOW/LATE_CANCEL -> ledger -1 + sisa berkurang; valid/teacher cancel -> 0 + sync Sheets
flows.pilot_placement: placement -> 02_PLACEMENT_RAW (Total max 50) + update 04 (Pre max 10, tidak dicampur)

pilot_tabs.01_REGISTRATION_RAW: 20 kolom form pendaftaran (jangan rename, terhubung GForm)
pilot_tabs.04_STUDENT_MASTER: 33 kolom, 1 siswa = 1 baris, Student_ID manual immutable, header baris 3
pilot_tabs.05_CLASS_MASTER: 19 kolom, 1 kelas = 1 baris, header baris 3, CLS-000001 <-> CLS-PUB-KIDS-01

id_bridge.STU-XXXXXX: ID siswa kanonikal seumur hidup (KOL-POL-COD-001); dipakai di Supabase, Sheets 04, dan web
id_bridge.CLS-XXXXXX: ID kelas kanonikal; CLS-000001/000002 dipetakan ke CLS-PUB-KIDS-01/CLS-PUB-TEEN-01
id_bridge.TXN-YYYY-####: ID transaksi setelah dana terverifikasi; satu pengerjaan asesmen = satu ATM-######

Semua mutasi ter-antre di localStorage kolase_sheets_queue dan di-POST sebagai action register/checkout/verify/attendance/register_pilot/placement/postclass/observation.
